crossRefs.note: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul…
As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that…
“But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where…
not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

translations.web: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
translations.bsb: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the slacker to those who send him.
